rows.grounds: compound: lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (letter/syllable) + rāśi (mass) + stha (situated); qualifies lakṣaṃ
object of the action expressed by kṛtya
gerund expressing completion of the repetition
compound vocative: sura (god) + arcita (worshipped); address to the deity

items.question: What specific mantra repetition is enjoined for the deity worshipped by gods?
premises: A repetition numbering one hundred thousand is prescribed.
This repetition is situated in the mass of letters on the forehead.
The injunction is addressed to the deity worshipped by gods.
items.inference: One must perform a hundred-thousand repetition situated in the forehead letter mass for the god-worshipped deity.
uncertainties: The exact referent of varṇa-rāśi (syllables, letters, or a specific mantra cluster) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: O deity worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred-thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters on the forehead.
